performance.verdict: Zero leads in 28 days exposes a conversion tracking or landing-page break, not just spend pullback.

findings.text: 131 Google clicks and $621.80 spent across 28 days yielded 0 leads — confirmed conversion tracking failure or broken landing-page form, not ad performance.
SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) has no completed-event confirmation — payment-path integrity is unverified 42 days overdue.
GBP drove 49 direction requests in 28 days with 0 calls recorded — strong local intent exists but no paid or organic call path is capturing it.
3-day spend signal (Aug 28–30): $21.62, $1.38, $6.86 — spend collapsing to near-zero vs prior 3 days ($13.98, $19.69, $21.62), confirming budget is draining out of auction.
GHL shows 172 contacts and 138 opportunities created with 0 won and 0 appointments — pipeline exists but no intake flow is converting; ads are not the blocker here.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tag and landing-page form submission end-to-end; 131 clicks, $621.80 spent, 0 conversions recorded.
suggestions.monday_update: Run a live test click through the BWS - Search Campaign - Calls ad to the landing page and submit a test lead. Confirm the conversion fires in Google Ads and appears in GHL contacts. With 131 clicks and $621.80 spent producing 0 leads, this is either a broken pixel or a broken form — not an ad quality issue. If confirmed broken, pause spend until the tag is verified firing.

suggestions.text: Verify Stripe Products QA milestone: run one live order through each intake path; 42 days overdue, cash leak risk.
suggestions.monday_update: Execute one test order through the WordPress/Stripe/Zapier path and one through GHL Products Payment - BWS. Confirm exactly one opportunity is created per order, fully field-mapped, with no duplicates. This milestone was marked done on 2026-07-20 but has no completed-event confirmation — 42 days of unverified payment flow is a silent cash-leak risk. Target completion and sign-off by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP call volume: 49 directions, 0 calls in 28 days — confirm call button is live and tracked before any paid action.
suggestions.monday_update: Manually test the GBP call button from a mobile device and confirm it routes correctly and registers in GHL or the reporting dashboard. GBP generated 49 direction requests but recorded 0 calls — this gap either means the call button is broken or calls are untracked. Re-check on 2026-09-03; if calls remain at zero with direction volume holding, escalate to a fix action.
